newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO BONDES RATES RISE SLIGHTLY AT AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO BONDES RATES RISE SLIGHTLY AT AUCTION.

text.p: The rate on the Mexican government's 364-day development bonds, or Bondes, rose 0.06 percentage points to 1.22 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate at an assigned price of 98.88929 pesos, dealers said.
The Bondes were auctioned at the weekly primary auction on Tuesday.
The demand of 460 million pesos was less than the 500 million one-year Bondes on offer.
The rate on Mexican government 728-day Bondes rose 0.02 percentage points to 1.21 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate, dealers estimated.
The 728-day Bondes were assigned at 98.00655 pesos.
Demand for the two-year Bondes was 1.635 billion pesos, compared to the 500 million offered by Banco de Mexico.
